title: About Forge Rehab & Performance
questions: Forge Rehab & Performance is a one-on-one physical therapy practice designed for active individuals, athletes, and weekend warriors. Treatment combines hands-on physical therapy, individualized exercise, strength training, and performance-based rehabilitation to help you recover, build, and perform at your best.
We work with active adults, recreational athletes, competitive athletes, and anyone looking to move better, get stronger, recover from injury, or return to the activities they enjoy.
Do I need to be an athlete to come to Forge?
Not at all. You don’t need to be a competitive athlete or even consider yourself an athlete. If you’re active and want to move, feel, and perform better, Forge is built for you.
